tools.name: get-asset

assetId.description: The ID of the asset to retrieve.

tools.name: search-bookmarks
tools.description: Search for bookmarks matching a specific query using full-text, semantic, or hybrid search.

query.description:
By default, this will do a full-text search, but you can also use qualifiers to filter the results.
You can search bookmarks using specific qualifiers. is:fav finds favorited bookmarks,
is:archived searches archived bookmarks, is:tagged finds those with tags,
is:inlist finds those in lists, and is:link, is:text, and is:media filter by bookmark type.
url:<value> searches for URL substrings, #<tag> searches for bookmarks with a specific tag,
list:<name> searches for bookmarks in a specific list given its name (without the icon),
after:<date> finds bookmarks created on or after a date (YYYY-MM-DD), and before:<date> finds bookmarks created on or before a date (YYYY-MM-DD).
If you need to pass names with spaces, you can quote them with double quotes. If you want to negate a qualifier, prefix it with a minus sign.
## Examples:

### Find favorited bookmarks from 2023 that are tagged "important"
is:fav after:2023-01-01 before:2023-12-31 #important

### Find archived bookmarks that are either in "reading" list or tagged "work"
is:archived and (list:reading or #work)

### Combine text search with qualifiers
machine learning is:fav

limit.description: The number of results to return in a single query.

nextCursor.description: The next cursor to use for pagination. The value for this is returned from a previous call to this tool.

sortOrder.description: Sort by relevance or creation date. Defaults to relevance.

searchMode.description: Search strategy. 'fts' uses full-text search, 'semantic' uses embeddings, and 'hybrid' combines both. Semantic and hybrid modes only support relevance sorting. Defaults to 'fts'.

tools.name: get-bookmark
tools.description: Get a bookmark by id.

tools.name: get-bookmark-lists
tools.description: List every list that contains a bookmark.

bookmarkId.description: The id of the bookmark whose lists to retrieve.

tools.name: create-bookmark
tools.description: Create a link bookmark or a text bookmark

type.description: The type of bookmark to create.

content.description: If type is text, the text to be bookmarked. If the type is link, then it's the URL to be bookmarked.

tools.name: update-bookmark
tools.description: Update fields on an existing bookmark. Only the fields you pass are modified; omitted fields stay unchanged. Returns the updated bookmark.

title.description: The bookmark's user-set title. Pass null to clear it.

note.description: A free-form note on the bookmark.

summary.description: The bookmark's summary. Pass null to clear it.

url.description: New URL for a link bookmark.

description.description: Link description. Pass null to clear it.

author.description: Link author. Pass null to clear it.

publisher.description: Link publisher. Pass null to clear it.

tools.name: get-bookmark-content
tools.description: Get the content of the bookmark in markdown

bookmarkId.description: The bookmarkId to get content for.

tools.name: delete-bookmark
tools.description: Delete a bookmark by id. This is destructive — the bookmark, its highlights, and its assets are removed.

bookmarkId.description: The id of the bookmark to delete.

tools.name: list-highlights
tools.description: List highlights across all bookmarks, newest first.

limit.description: Maximum number of highlights to return per page.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

tools.name: get-bookmark-highlights
tools.description: List every highlight on a bookmark.

bookmarkId.description: The id of the bookmark whose highlights to retrieve.

tools.name: get-highlight
tools.description: Retrieve a single highlight by id.

highlightId.description: The id of the highlight to retrieve.

tools.name: create-highlight
tools.description: Create a text highlight on a bookmark using character offsets from the bookmark's readable content.

bookmarkId.description: The id of the bookmark to highlight.

text.description: The highlighted text, or null if unavailable.

note.description: An optional note attached to the highlight.

tools.name: update-highlight
tools.description: Update a highlight's color or note.

highlightId.description: The id of the highlight to update.

note.description: New note. Pass null to clear it.

tools.name: delete-highlight
tools.description: Delete a highlight by id.

highlightId.description: The id of the highlight to delete.

tools.name: get-lists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of lists.

tools.name: get-list
tools.description: Retrieve a single list by its id.

listId.description: The id of the list to retrieve.

tools.name: update-list
tools.description: Update a list. Only the fields you pass are changed. Length caps and smart-list query rules come from the shared list schema.

listId.description: The id of the list to update.

icon.description: New emoji icon for the list.

description.description: New description for the list. Pass null to clear.

parentId.description: New parent list id. Pass null to move to the root.

query.description: New smart-list query. Only meaningful for smart lists.

public.description: Whether the list is publicly accessible.

tools.name: delete-list
tools.description: Delete a list by id. Bookmarks inside the list are not deleted. Child lists are also not deleted. Any child lists become root-level lists (their parentId is set to null). If that isn't the tree change you want, move or re-parent the children before calling this.

listId.description: The id of the list to delete.

tools.name: add-bookmark-to-list
tools.description: Add a bookmark to a list.

listId.description: The listId to add the bookmark to.

tools.name: remove-bookmark-from-list
tools.description: Remove a bookmark from a list.

listId.description: The listId to remove the bookmark from.

tools.name: get-list-bookmarks
tools.description: List bookmarks in a list by its stable id. Smart lists are evaluated using their saved query.

listId.description: The id of the list whose bookmarks to retrieve.

sortOrder.description: Sort by creation date. Defaults to newest first.

limit.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return per page.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

includeContent.description: Whether to include each bookmark's full content.

tools.name: create-list
tools.description: Create a list.

icon.description: The emoji icon of the list.

parentId.description: The parent list id of this list.

tools.name: attach-tag-to-bookmark
tools.description: Attach a tag to a bookmark.

bookmarkId.description: The bookmarkId to attach the tag to.

tools.name: detach-tag-from-bookmark
tools.description: Detach a tag from a bookmark.

bookmarkId.description: The bookmarkId to detach the tag from.

tools.name: get-tags
tools.description: List tags with their bookmark counts. Supports filtering and pagination.

nameContains.description: Filter tags whose name contains this substring.

sort.description: Sort order. 'relevance' requires nameContains. Defaults to 'usage'.

attachedBy.description: Filter by how the tag was attached.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

tools.name: get-tag
tools.description: Retrieve a single tag by id, including its bookmark counts.

tagId.description: The id of the tag to retrieve.

tools.name: update-tag
tools.description: Rename a tag. The new name is normalized by the server.

tagId.description: The id of the tag to update.

name.description: New name for the tag. Will be normalized by the server.

tools.name: delete-tag
tools.description: Delete a tag by id. Bookmarks that had this tag are not deleted; the tag is just removed from them.

tagId.description: The id of the tag to delete.

tools.name: get-tag-bookmarks
tools.description: List bookmarks that have a given tag, with pagination.

tagId.description: The id of the tag whose bookmarks to fetch.

sortOrder.description: Sort order by creation date. Defaults to 'desc'.

limit.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return per page.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response to fetch the next page.

includeContent.description: If true, include each bookmark's full content. Defaults to false.
